thesis: Scientific simplicity is valuable when it generates precise tests and states its domain; the universe owes no elegance.

ideas.statement: Honest simplicity counts assumptions and hidden exceptions; an approximation can be beautiful through explicit limits rather than universal reach.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Noether connects continuous symmetries under mathematical assumptions to conservation; actual physical applicability needs independent establishment.
